text.p: - Russia stops meat imports from China.
- Liberal politician Grigory Yavlinsky says members of his Yabloko bloc could join the government if certain conditions are met.
- President Boris Yeltsin's son-in-law comes to the helm of Russian airline Aeroflot.
- The State Pension Fund is still running short of cash.
- President Yeltsin is keeping the list of his new government secret.
- Tax authorities start comprehensive checks of all commercial banks.
- President Yeltsin signs a new decree supposed to help raise funds for the Pension Fund.
- Russia must achieve a breakthrough in the economy or face a crisis which could run to the end of the century.
- Finance Minister Alexander Livshits manages to get Russia more than $1 billion in a eurobond issue.
- Russian regions favour a one-team government.
- The list of those who are going to leave the government is already drawn up.
